product: Workday enterprise AI platform for HR, finance and IT: organic agents (Recruiting Agent handled 14 million hiring processes in Q1, up 44 percent YoY, 2026-05-21 8-K), Sana learning and ITSM, Adaptive Decision Intelligence, Financial Audit Agent, Agent System of Record, plus Total Benefits (2026-09-24) and unified frontline workforce and payroll (2026-09-17).

bull: Q2 FY2027 (2026-08-27 8-K) beat: subscription revenue 2.471B up 13.9%, margin 31.1%, EPS 2.75 vs 2.61; FY2027 margin guide raised to 31.0%; AI over 25% of new ACV; 20 of 24 analysts raised targets in 90 days.

falsifier: Q3 FY2027 results (estimated 2026-11-24) with subscription revenue below the guided 2.515B USD or non-GAAP margin below 30.0%, or total backlog growth at or under 10%.

Last 30 days: Total Benefits launched 2026-09-24, frontline payroll platform 2026-09-17, new CMO named 2026-09-10 (newsroom); David Duffield sold about 19.1M USD of stock 2026-09-24 (MarketBeat).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Founder Aneel Bhusri returned as CEO 2026-02-09, replacing Carl Eschenbach (SEC 8-K EX-99.1). AI drove over 25 percent of new ACV and 5,500-plus customers use organic agents, up over 35 percent QoQ (2026-08-27 8-K). But total subscription backlog growth slowed to 8.0 percent YoY from 10.9 percent in Q1 (2026-08-27 vs 2026-05-21 8-K), a deceleration analysts may under-weight.
web_demand_product: Workday enterprise AI platform for HR, finance and IT: organic agents (Recruiting Agent handled 14 million hiring processes in Q1, up 44 percent YoY, 2026-05-21 8-K), Sana learning and ITSM, Adaptive Decision Intelligence, Financial Audit Agent, Agent System of Record, plus Total Benefits (2026-09-24) and unified frontline workforce and payroll (2026-09-17).
web_price_volume_mix: Mostly volume plus AI-driven mix, not headline price. Subscription revenue rose 13.9 percent YoY (2026-08-27 8-K) while 12-month backlog rose 14.2 percent and total backlog only 8.0 percent (2026-08-27). Customer community over 11,500 organizations and over 80 million users under contract (2026-05-21 8-K). No explicit list-price increase found.
web_bottleneck: Trust and verification of AI agents in regulated HR and finance workflows. Workday launched Agent Passport to test, verify and continuously monitor every agent and Developer Agent for natural-language building (2026-08-27 8-K), signalling this is the constraint; it relieves enterprise HCM/ERP fragmentation and manual benefits, audit and payroll work (2026-09-24 newsroom).
web_who_benefits_next: Hyperscaler and integration partners: AWS (Workday Data Cloud bi-directional zero-copy integration) and Google Cloud (Workday agents inside Gemini Enterprise), both named 2026-08-27 (8-K); payroll and verification partners Block Cash App and Experian (2026-09-24/25 MarketBeat). Second order: benefits administration, audit and vendor-management ecosystems pulled onto Workday platform.
web_who_loses: Legacy on-premise and point-solution HR and finance vendors (payroll, benefits, VMS, learning) and AI-native HR startups lose seat revenue as Workday agents absorb work; the manual systems-integrator and BPO layer is disintermediated. Internally, co-founder David Duffield cut his position nearly 49 percent, selling 99,613 shares near 19.1M USD on 2026-09-24 (MarketBeat).
web_margin_collapse_risk: AI compute cost and share-based compensation. web_low_cost_substitute: Not found. No Chinese low-cost enterprise HCM/ERP substitute was identified with dated evidence; competition cited in Workday risk factors is Western (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, ADP) plus AI-native entrants (2026-08-27 8-K). No dated pricing evidence found.
